summary: Tested the Telnyx international pay-first verification flow end-to-end by driving the real bot (webhook :5000) against mock Telegram (:5099) and mock Telnyx-reg (:5098). I wrote 7 scenario scripts (A–G) and ran 76 checks: 72 passed, 2 failed on real bugs, 1 failed only because of the sandbox, and 1 failed because two of my own tests ran at the same time. Working: GB/NL/IL/NZ summary note (PR/CO show none), wallet charge before verification, Payment received / Step 2 intro, session doc with refund, cpTxReg routing, name/phone/email/country validation, Individual button, Back on steps and on the review screen, doc rules (zip rejected, PDF over 10MB rejected, text rejected, PDF and photo accepted), review summary and buttons, submit to under_review (order body has the address id, textual values and 2 doc ids, no messaging_profile_id), order error refunds, 'not available' retries once with a fresh real number, double Cancel refunds exactly once, /cancel in the flow and from the main menu, hub resume menu (Resume / Start Over / Cancel & Refund), the sweeper's 6h reminder (sent once) and 48h expiry with refund, the poller's rejection refund, French texts, and the sub-number block (wallet path refunds). Real bugs: (1) Telnyx address validation returns HTTP 422 for invalid addresses, so the addr_check step never appears; (2) a closed session can be put back to 'collecting', which can lead to a double refund.

critical.issue: Real Telnyx POST /addresses/actions/validate returns HTTP 422 when the result is 'invalid' (checked: NZ 'Xyzzy 99999, Qwerty, 0000' gives 422 with result:'invalid' and error 20200; IL with postal skipped gives 422 'Missing postal code'). axios throws on 422, the catch returns {result:'unavailable'}, and the address is silently accepted. So the addr_check buttons (Use suggested / Keep / Re-enter) are never shown. createAddress then sends validate_address:true because keptInvalid was never set. In production the real POST /addresses will probably reject it at submit, so the user gets a refund only after filling in everything. Repro: tests/test_tx_payfirst_F_addrcheck.js (F1, F2, F5 and F6 fail; bot log shows '[TelnyxReg] address validate unavailable (NZ): Invalid address'). Fix: use validateStatus:s=>s<500 (or read e.response.data when status is 422) and map data.result/errors to 'invalid'. Also treat an empty d.suggested {} as no suggestion: today addressLine({}) still returns the country name, so a useless 'Use suggested address' button would appear.

reply() does sessions.replaceOne({_id: s._id}, s) with no status guard. If the session is closed (sweeper 48h expiry with refund, or Cancel) while an answer is still being processed (for example during the live address-validation call), the in-flight save writes status:'collecting' back over 'expired'/'cancelled'. A session that was already refunded becomes active again, and a later Cancel, /cancel or expiry refunds it a second time. Repro: tests/test_tx_payfirst_G_race_resurrect.js (G1 fails: status goes back to 'collecting'). Fix: replaceOne({_id: s._id, status:'collecting'}, s) and, if matchedCount is 0, return null or a 'session closed' reply. Same in the Back branch, which uses reply().

minor.issue: '🔄 Purchasing your number...' (line ~13967, and also sent in the bank, BlockBee and DynoPay paths) appears before '✅ Payment received — Step 2 of 2 verification'. This is misleading for regulated countries.

The guard runs after the charge: the user pays, sees 'This country needs identity verification...', then 'Failed to purchase number. Your wallet has been refunded'. Net zero, but 3 confusing messages. The country-select guard (line 30722) only works when TWILIO_ENABLED=false. In this sandbox TWILIO_ENABLED is unset, so allCountries is the Twilio list and the country-select guard is not reached (test B26 could not be reproduced here). Consider also blocking at the order summary (selection time) when cpIsSubNumber is set and the country has requirements.
No auditCryptoTx call, unlike the BlockBee branch (line 40813) and the normal DynoPay Telnyx path (46125). The crypto audit trail is missing for DynoPay-paid verifications.

When ngnIn > ngnPrice, the excess is credited immediately (line ~39703). The later failure paths then refund the full ngnIn (for example after telnyxPaidCheckout returns null), so the excess is credited twice. The verification refund itself is correct: min(ngnIn, ngnPrice) in ngn.

If anything throws outside placeRegulatedOrder (for example the insertOne catch path), the session stays in 'submitting' forever. The sweeper only looks at 'collecting', so there is no automatic refund (an admin alert is sent only for the insert failure). Consider a sweep for 'submitting' sessions older than N minutes.
Always shows 'paid $<usd price>', even for sessions paid by bank in NGN (the refund is in ₦).

action_items: HIGH: Fix validateAddress to treat HTTP 422 with data.result 'invalid' (or any errors) as invalid, so addr_check (Keep / Re-enter / Use suggested) actually appears. Ignore an empty 'suggested' {} object.
HIGH: Guard handleInput's reply() replaceOne with status:'collecting' to prevent a closed, already-refunded session from becoming active again (double-refund risk).
Minor: Don't send 'Purchasing your number...' before the verification intro for regulated countries.
Minor: Add auditCryptoTx to the DynoPay _verification branch.
Minor: Block sub-numbers for regulated countries before payment (at the summary), not only after the charge.
Minor (pre-existing): bank NGN overpay excess is credited twice on failure.
Minor: Add a timeout sweep for sessions stuck in 'submitting'.
critical_code_review_comments: telnyx-regulatory.js http(): axios uses the default validateStatus, so every Telnyx 4xx response body is lost. This matters for /addresses/actions/validate, where 422 carries the business result.

handleInput Cancel branch: when closeSession returns null (lost the race), it still returns the 'refunded' text with refundable:false. The user can see 'has been refunded' without a refund happening (only in a race; harmless otherwise).
Number-gone retry creates a second address and uploads the documents again (duplicate Telnyx resources). It works, but re-using addressId/documentIds from the first attempt would be cleaner.

utils.sendMessage (used by refundTelnyxPending and addFundsTo) hardcodes https://api.telegram.org and ignores TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL. That is fine in production, but in the sandbox the 'Verification not approved' message is never seen by the mock (C10 fails only because of the sandbox; the bot log shows the correct text was attempted).
_index.js is ~51.8k lines; the new Telnyx checkout/poller block (~250 lines at 1300-1550) could live in its own module.

success_rate.backend: 95% (72/76 checks pass; 2 fail on real bugs: addr_check never shown, session resurrection race; C10 fails only because of the sandbox: utils.sendMessage bypasses the mock; F7 fails because tests ran at the same time: C's failure config leaked into F)

seed_data_creation: Throwaway chat ids 990300021-990300091 seeded into state/walletOf. All cleaned up (tests/_cleanup_tx.js clears every 9903000xx id). Mock Telnyx /_config reset to pending/no error. backend/.env not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the scenarios with `node js/tests/test_tx_payfirst_<X>.js` (B takes subsets: fail,gone,cancel,slash,resume,il,fr,sub,race). C needs about 5 minutes (it waits for the in-bot 5-min poller); pass the chatId of an existing under_review pending order as argv[2], for example run A with KEEP=1 first and then pass 990300021. Do NOT run C at the same time as other scenarios (it sets the mock order_status to failure). The French wallet button is '👛 Payer $X via Portefeuille'. TWILIO_ENABLED is unset in the sandbox, so the sub-number country-select guard can't be tested here. Never pay for PR/CO (real buyNumber) and never test the approved path.
rca of the issue: Address check: Telnyx's validate endpoint signals an invalid address with HTTP 422 plus data.result='invalid'. validateAddress relies on axios's default (throw on 4xx) and maps every exception to 'unavailable', which tryAuto treats as passed. Mitigation: validateStatus: s => s < 500 for this call, then read r.data. Resurrection: the read-modify-write in handleInput (getSession, then await advance() with network I/O, then replaceOne by _id only) has no optimistic-concurrency check against the atomic closeSession transition. Mitigation: include status:'collecting' in the replace filter.
